## Load all simulated datasets
```{r}
dat1 <- get(load("out/data/datDDMC1.RData"))
dat2 <- get(load("out/data/datDDMC2.RData"))
dat3 <- get(load("out/data/datDDMC3.RData"))
dat4 <- get(load("out/data/datDDMC4.RData"))
dat5 <- get(load("out/data/datDDMC5.RData"))
dat6 <- get(load("out/data/datDDMC6.RData"))

dat1$simulation <- 1
dat2$simulation <- 2
dat3$simulation <- 3
dat4$simulation <- 4
dat5$simulation <- 5
dat6$simulation <- 6

datAll <- rbind(dat1, dat2, dat3, dat4, dat5, dat6)
datAll <- mk_congruency(datAll)
datAll$congruency <- as.factor(datAll$congruency)
datAll$error <- ifelse(datAll$dec == 1, 0, 1)
```

## Helper Function(s)
```{r}
check_ceff <- function(dat, A1, A2, tau1, tau2) {
  df <- dat[
    dat$A1 == A1 & dat$A2 == A2 & dat$tau1 == tau1 & dat$tau2 == tau2 & 
      dat$dec == 1, ]
  
  meanrts <- aggregate(rt ~ congruency, FUN = mean, df)$rt
  ceff1 <- meanrts[2] - meanrts[1]
  ceff2 <- meanrts[4] - meanrts[3]
  diff_diffs <- ceff1 - ceff2
#  print(paste(
#    "A1 =", A1, "A2 =", A2, "tau1 =", tau1, "tau2 =", tau2, ":", 
#    "Diff (ci-cc) - (ii-ic) =", diff_diffs))
  return(diff_diffs)
}
```

## Heatmaps
```{r}
sim_nr <- 1   # select simulation
dat_nr <- "_1"    # set plot suffix
dat <- datDDMC[datDDMC$simulation == sim_nr, ]


param_grid <- expand.grid(
  tau1 = unique(dat$tau1), tau2 = unique(dat$tau2), 
  A1 = unique(dat$A1), A2 = unique(dat$A2)
)


param_grid$diffs <- NA
for (i in 1:nrow(param_grid)) {
  print(paste("processing set :", i))
  param_grid[i, ]$diffs <- check_ceff(dat, param_grid[i,]$A1, param_grid[i,]$A2, 
                                 param_grid[i,]$tau1, param_grid[i,]$tau2)
}

summary(param_grid$diffs)
sd(param_grid$diffs)
min(param_grid$diffs)
max(param_grid$diffs)

# Plot heatmaps for differences, vary As
plot_df <- param_grid %>%
  filter(tau1 == tau2)

pdf(paste0("../../script/images/heatmaps_varyAs", dat_nr, ".pdf"), 6, 4)
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = factor(A2), y = factor(A1), fill = diffs)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") + theme_minimal() + 
  facet_wrap(~ tau1, 
             labeller = label_bquote(paste(tau[1], " = ", tau[2], " = ", .(tau1)))) + 
  labs(x = expression(A[2]), y = expression(A[1])) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white",high = "orange", 
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-75, 75), name = "D")
dev.off()

# Plot heatmaps for differences, vary taus
plot_df <- param_grid %>%
  filter(A1 == A2)

pdf(paste0("../../script/images/heatmaps_varyTaus", dat_nr, ".pdf"), 6, 4)
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = factor(tau2), y = factor(tau1), fill = diffs)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") + theme_minimal() + 
  facet_wrap(~ A1, 
             labeller = label_bquote(paste(A[1], " = ", A[2], " = ", .(A1)))) + 
  labs(x = expression(tau[2]), y = expression(tau[1])) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white",high = "orange", 
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-75, 75), name = "D")
dev.off()
```

## OK parameter sets
```{r}
dat <- datAll

param_sets <- expand.grid(
  b = unique(datAll$b), mu_c = unique(datAll$mu_c), 
  A1 = unique(datAll$A1), A2 = unique(datAll$A2), 
  tau1 = unique(datAll$tau1), tau2 = unique(datAll$tau2)
)

# mean ERs, RTs per parameter set & congruency
ers_rts <- aggregate(
  cbind(error, rt) ~ A1 + A2 + tau1 + tau2 + b + mu_c + congruency, dat, mean
)
caf_data <- dat %>% 
  group_by(A1, A2, tau1, tau2, mu_c, b, congruency) %>% 
  mutate(rt_bin = ntile(rt, 5)) %>%
  group_by(A1, A2, tau1, tau2, mu_c, b, congruency, rt_bin) %>% 
  summarise(mean_acc = mean(1-error), mean_rt = mean(rt), .groups = "drop")

# add mean ER and first bin accuracy in i-i
param_sets <- param_sets %>% 
  left_join(
    ers_rts %>% 
      filter(congruency == "incongruent_incongruent") %>% 
      select(A1, A2, tau1, tau2, b, mu_c, error_ii = error), 
    by = c("A1", "A2", "tau1", "tau2", "b", "mu_c")
  ) %>% 
  left_join(
    caf_data %>% 
      filter(congruency == "incongruent_incongruent", rt_bin == 1) %>% 
      select(A1, A2, tau1, tau2, b, mu_c, mean_acc_bin1_ii = mean_acc), 
    by = c("A1", "A2", "tau1", "tau2", "b", "mu_c")
  )
head(param_sets)

param_sets |> sort_by(~ list(-mean_acc_bin1_ii)) # sort highest first bin acc
param_sets |> sort_by(~ list(mean_acc_bin1_ii))  # sort lowest first bin acc

# select OK parameter sets  
param_sets_OK <- param_sets[
  param_sets$error_ii < 0.15 & param_sets$mean_acc_bin1_ii > 0.6, 
]
str(param_sets_OK)

# D score
param_sets_OK$diffs <- NA
for (i in 1:nrow(param_sets_OK)) {
  print(paste("processing set :", i))
  param_sets_OK[i, ]$diffs <- check_ceff(
    dat, param_sets_OK[i,]$A1, param_sets_OK[i,]$A2, 
    param_sets_OK[i,]$tau1, param_sets_OK[i,]$tau2
  )
}
save(param_sets_OK, file = "out/data/param_sets_OK.RData")
```

plot_df_6 <- dat[dat$A1 == dat$A2 & dat$mu_c == 0.5 & dat$b == 50, ]

plot_df_taus <- function(plot_df) {
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = factor(tau2), y = factor(tau1), fill = diffs)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") + theme_minimal() + 
    facet_wrap(~ A1, 
               labeller = label_bquote(paste(A[1], " = ", A[2], " = ", .(A1)))) + 
    labs(x = expression(tau[2]), y = expression(tau[1])) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white",high = "orange", 
                         midpoint = 0, limits = c(-75, 75), name = "D")
}

plot_dfs <- list(plot_df_1, plot_df_2, plot_df_3, plot_df_4, plot_df_5, plot_df_6)
pdf("../../script/images/heatmaps_varyTaus_OK.pdf", 6, 4)
lapply(plot_dfs, plot_df_taus)
dev.off()
